review.verdict: G1 lens (QL2-1 and the two guarded-source follow-ups) at 00fdbf4a971752e9b9182b1404adad2dd1e7e675 vs 7a2bf7533f5c26d98e0bdb34a862852942b2914e: IMPLEMENTED AS SPECIFIED AND FAIL-SAFE ON THE WALKED TRUTH TABLE. No P0, P1 or P2 within this lens. The in-flight marker is persisted before every POST, cannot be overwritten by the write-through effect during a POST, restores as uncertain with the same key and acceptedAt, and the stamp is released only on a definitive refusal observed by the live page before any uncertain outcome; the catch still promotes to uncertain and the conflict branch now persists uncertain (QL2-6). The generation counter and stillOwned checks cover every await; a late success or refusal from a lost or disowned page stores no credential, writes no draft, releases no stamp and navigates nowhere, and the committed request remains reachable by the page that owns the attempt through replay of the same key and stamp. The ownership preflight runs before stamping, writing or sending; storage-unavailable browsers keep the base in-memory behaviour; no legitimate first submission is blocked; no new false success or duplicate path was found; identity isolation is unchanged and strengthened (no repopulation and no token write after the sweep; the base's latent clearing of a newer attempt's draft by a dead page's late success is gone). Seven P3 items are named: an unobservable silent-idle on a live-but-disowned page, a storedOnce initialisation corner for a restored page whose mount write fails, the in-flight marker being set outside the try, the suppressed-late-success window needing a line in the QL2-3 disclosure (which still names only 3a03ad6), three page-level test gaps, one test that cannot fail for the behaviour it names, and the pre-existing QL2-5 notice-slot carry. Behaviour was reasoned, not run; the full-suite, typecheck, CLI, companion and build receipts are relied on as established by the reviewer and were not re-verified here. Nothing in G1 blocks acceptance of the candidate-bound source verdict; the route, browser, served-version and database checks are outside this lens and remain separately tracked.

findings.title: The suppressed late success after a sweep has no client-side way back and is not yet in the QL2-3 disclosure
